title: Secure named partner (food-bank network / 211 / mutual aid); confirm region + last-mile verification
context: The project's Definition of Shipped (partner-adopted) requires a named partner org — a food-bank network, 211/AIRS center, community-action agency, or mutual-aid org — that confirms the need in writing and commits to the last-mile human verification that AI cannot do. Until a partner is secured, verifiedNeed = false and the project is 'publicly usable' but not 'shipped' by Elyos's delivered-not-merged bar. A 6-month post-M3 decision point exists: if no partner is secured by then, governance may declare 'Publicly Shipped (generic public good)' instead.
objective: Identify, contact, and secure commitment from ≥1 named partner organization (food-bank network, 211/AIRS center, community-action agency, or mutual-aid org) that: (1) confirms the need in writing (letter of support or lightweight MOU); (2) names a priority region for the dataset; (3) ideally commits to assist with last-mile human verification (phone/visit confirmation); and (4) agrees to the data-sharing/attribution terms. Document the engagement and record the signed commitment in the project's governance files.
acceptanceCriteria: ≥1 named partner organization identified and contacted with a clear description of the project, its outputs, and the ask
The partner confirms the need in writing — either a letter of support or a lightweight MOU is signed and filed in the repo's governance directory
The partner names a priority region (city, county, or metropolitan area) to guide regional coverage
The commitment document is filed in docs/partnerships/ with the partner name, organization type, date, region, and scope of commitment
The steward updates verifiedNeed to true and requestor to the named org across all task files upon confirmation
If the partner commits to last-mile human verification, a verification rota or point of contact is documented
The engagement process (outreach approach, talking points, what was shared) is documented so future partners can be recruited using the same approach
If no partner is secured within the 6-month post-M3 window, the steward triggers the 'Publicly Shipped (generic public good)' governance review
output: docs/partnerships/<partner-name>-commitment.md (signed letter/MOU and engagement notes) + a governance update setting verifiedNeed and requestor.
